absolute.gloss: Finish the job quickly. Efficiency first. Hurry. Alpha=0; beta is unused.
Otherwise normal, but keep more space from the human.
Balanced default. As usual. Neither hurried nor extra-cautious.
Otherwise normal, but unhurried / do not rush.
Safety first by staying farther from the human.
Safety first, balanced between slow and far.

relative.gloss: A little slower than now. One 5x5 step toward slow.
Much slower than now. Two 5x5 steps toward slow.
A little faster / more efficient than now. One step down in alpha.
Much faster / much more efficient. Two steps down in alpha.
A little more distance than now. One 5x5 step toward far.
Much more distance than now. Two 5x5 steps toward far.
A little more careful than now. One step up in alpha.
Much more careful than now. Two steps up in alpha.

special.gloss: Return to the default balanced setting.
Not a speed/distance preference. Keep the current setting.
